cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel,avg(speed) as avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS num_readings FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT max(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, vessel, max(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY day, vessel ORDER BY day, vessel

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hour', ts) AS bucket, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY bucket, vessel ORDER BY bucket, vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', ts) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.reason: right values, day_of_week returned as text
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT strftime('%w', ts) AS day_of_week, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql:
-- view: tracks
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minute',ts) AS time, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY time,vessel ORDER BY time,vessel

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS time, AVG(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts <= '2026-09-05 23:59:54' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql:
-- view: tracks
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS time, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND vessel != 'Aurora' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel,count(*) AS num_readings FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS time, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY time, vessel ORDER BY time, vessel

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT count(DISTINCT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)) AS num_hours
FROM telemetry
WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS bucket, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY avg_wave_height DESC LIMIT 10

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, water_temp FROM telemetry ORDER BY water_temp LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT vessel, MAX(lon) AS max_lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY max_lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT
  AVG(wind) AS avg_wind,
  vessel,
  AVG(speed) AS avg_speed
FROM
  telemetry
GROUP BY
  vessel
ORDER BY
  avg_wind,
  vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, max(water_temp) - min(water_temp) AS temp_diff FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wave_height) / AVG(wind) AS ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed * 1.852) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql:
-- view: bar
SELECT CASE WHEN ts < '2026-09-08 00:00:00' THEN 'First Week' ELSE 'Second Week' END AS week, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry WHERE ts = '2026-09-14 23:59:54' ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT lat,lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' LIMIT 1

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
-- view: map
SELECT vessel, lat, lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel, lat, lon ORDER BY vessel, lat, lon LIMIT 5000

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel,count(*) AS num_readings FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, AVG(lat) AS avg_lat, AVG(lon) AS avg_lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql:
-- view: heatmap
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS time, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY time, vessel ORDER BY time, vessel

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS time, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY time, vessel ORDER BY time, vessel

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT AVG(wind),AVG(wave_height) FROM telemetry GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) ORDER BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)
